To switch on? (\textbf{allumer}.) To switch off? (\textbf{éteindre}.) To jump? (\textbf{sauter}.) To smile? (\textbf{sourire}.) To shout? (\textbf{crier}.) To explain? (\textbf{expliquer}.) To translate? (\textbf{traduire}.) To decide? (\textbf{décider}.) To try? (\textbf{essayer}.) To continue? (\textbf{continuer}.) To sign? (\textbf{signer}.) To fill in a form? (\textbf{remplir un formulaire}.) To phone? (\textbf{téléphoner}.) To discuss? (\textbf{discuter}.) To quarrel? (\textbf{se disputer}.) To be bored? (\textbf{s'ennuyer}.) To have fun? (\textbf{s'amuser}.) To get angry? (\textbf{se fâcher}.) To worry? (\textbf{s'inquiéter}.) To smoke? (\textbf{fumer}.)
